mentions.name: RiffRaff
mentions.description: This app aggregates local music events in the author's area by scraping a variety of websites and APIs, with some LLM processing mixed in, and publishes the results as an event listing site.
mentions.problem: Manually searching many different websites and Instagram to find local music events is tedious.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building an app that aggregates music events in my area.  I got tired of trying to manually search different web sites, instagram, etc.  So it scrapes a bunch of websites and APIs plus some LLM-magic sprinkled in to create https://riffraff.show
